analysis.themes: A stunt driver moonlighting as a getaway wheelman becomes a fairy-tale knight whose armor is a scorpion jacket — romance and brutality share the same stillness.
analysis.atmosphere: Neon cool stretched taut; the film's dreamlike calm makes its sudden violence land like ruptures in a trance.
analysis.narrative: A deliberately simple fable — driver, girl, debt — executed with archetypal confidence; the story is an excuse for myth.
analysis.visual: Graphic, glossy compositions and synth-soaked night photography made 'neon noir' an aesthetic category.
analysis.characters: The Driver is a man of maybe fifty lines — a blank archetype onto which tenderness and psychopathy are projected equally.
